# Nagarjuna Kamireddy

> Lead AI Architect with 22 years in enterprise data platforms (SAP BW, BPC, HANA) and production machine learning and generative AI systems (John Deere, Persistent Systems, Vertiv, Soham Global, GlaxoSmithKline UK). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02) and NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI).

## Open-Source Repositories

- [enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server): OData v4 Model Context Protocol server with EDM schema validation, row-level BUKRS authorization, PII masking, and write-approval gates.
- [enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails): Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval assistant with RBAC filtering, calibrated low-confidence refusal, and citation checks.
- [aegis-runtime](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Deny-by-default capability policy language, out-of-sandbox credential broker, multi-actor session isolation, compensating sagas, compaction attribution, and signed audit logs.
- [prism-gate](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with TCP-Vegas concurrency limits, bounded zero-text decision routing, PipeAxes prefill slicing, cost-aware cascades, and switch-adapted drift checks.
- [vecta](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): Filtered HNSW, IVF-PQ, RaBitQ, and hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval engine with C++20 distance kernels.
- [syntara](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-constrained decoding compiling JSON Schema and regular expressions into C++20 byte DFAs, paired with amount-scaled cost-matrix decision optimization.
- [company-os](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): Config-driven 7-agent operations runtime with SHACL 3-way knowledge-graph merges, OKF procedure memory distillation, Kanban board, and KPI tracking.
- [adaptive-ai-tutor](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/adaptive-ai-tutor): 12-agent GPT-4o learning platform with prerequisite DAGs, Socratic coaching, rubric grading, and Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma).
- [llm-knowledge-base](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/llm-knowledge-base): Incremental Markdown wiki builder, SQLite FTS5 search, and cited Q&A service (FastAPI).
- [langgraph-newsroom](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/langgraph-newsroom): 3-stage LangGraph editorial workflow with human approval checkpoints, SQLite persistence, and bounded error recovery.
- [governed-member-services-agent](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent): Multi-tenant member-services agent with policy enforcement, grounded citations, and a 40-case evaluation suite.
- [verispec-sdd](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd): Executable SPEC.md state-machine verifier for reachability, deadlocks, and Tarjan SCC livelocks with property-test synthesis.
- [skillbench](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench): Static information-flow taint analyzer and C++20 Aho-Corasick scanner for agent SKILL.md archives and MCP manifests.
- [weavegraph](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Dependency-aware git worktree scheduler with Tarjan SCC condensation and 3-way AST merge checks.
- [tracegit](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Content-addressed version control for agent execution traces with edit-distance diffing and regression bisection.
- [calibra](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Paired bootstrap, exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry CI, 2PL IRT, temperature scaling, and MinHash-LSH contamination checks.
- [enterprise-ai-field-guides](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-ai-field-guides): 19 open-access PDF field guides and handbooks on Hybrid RAG, Clean-Core OData MCP, Agent Evaluation, and Guardrails.

## Experience Summary

- **John Deere** (Pune, India) — AI Architect & Technical Lead (official title: Senior Data Scientist), `01/2023 – 10/2026`: Owned architecture, AWS Terraform/GitHub Actions deployment platform, and delivery for 23+ AI initiatives with a 12+ member team (750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26; StoneAge LangGraph + OpenSearch copilot; 6-agent Neo4j GraphRAG; ~30% to ~70% multimodal workflow turnaround; AIFlow 255 CI quality checks; AI Governance Council).
- **Persistent Systems** (Pune, India) — Engineering Lead — Machine Learning, `01/2021 – 01/2023`: End-to-end client ML deployments and MLOps across access recommendation, identity deduplication, computer vision, and NLP.
- **Vertiv** (Hyderabad, India) — Data Scientist, `03/2020 – 01/2021`: Compliance analytics and Customer 360 ML/DL pipelines on AWS Athena and Tableau.
- **Soham Global** (India) — Software Engineer — Machine Learning, `03/2016 – 02/2020`: Leakage-safe time-series forecasting, market-basket analysis, and recommendation systems.
- **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** (Brentford, UK) — HANA Lead Consultant — Data Platform & Predictive Analytics, `02/2014 – 02/2016`: In-database SAP HANA PAL/APL/R predictive models and financial consolidation optimization.
- **Earlier SAP BW / BPC / HANA Consulting** (`2004 – 2014`): GSK India & HCL Axon UK (`2012 – 2014`), PETRONAS Energy Trading & Deloitte Kuala Lumpur (`2011 – 2012`), DHL, Symantec & Khaga Malaysia/Singapore (`2008 – 2011`), Lenovo, SEAL InfoTech & High Industries Chennai/US (`2004 – 2008`).
- **Education:** M.Sc. (Integrated) Applied Science, Information Technology — Periyar University (`1999 – 2004`, First Class).
